Title Suit No.59 of 1984 was filed by the plaintiffs-appellants—petitioners, as from the certified copy of the order sheet, it appears that the suit was heard on a number of dates, thereafter, learned Judge of the trial Court, dismissed the suit on 28.2.1985. Thereafter, plaintiffs appellants petitioners filed Title Appeal No.147 of 1985 and from the order sheet it appears that the appeal was dismissed at 1 p.m. It is settled by the Supreme Court that default order should not be passed at 1 p.m., it ought to be passed at the end of the day, as, it may be that, for some other reason, litigant may be busy or their Advocates may busy at any other Court. It may be the litigant or learned Advocate may appear before raising of the Court. On a reading of the judgment, we find that learned Judge dismissed miscellaneous case on the ground that there is wrong mentioning of the date of knowledge whether it was on 28.2.1999 or some other date, as in the body of, the application it was written that litigant appellant petitioners could know on 05.07.1999 and filed application on 10.7.1999. It is true that learned Advocate mistakenly written as 28.2.1999 in place of 5.7.1999. It appears that the application was filed for readmission of the appeal on 10.7.1999. If it is calculated from 28.2.1999 even then it was not so late for which learned Judge. 

 deber the litigant from placing their case and also none suited them. It appears from the record of the appeal that before this Court plaintiffs appellant petitioners took some step relating for making the appeal ready for hearing and also filed substitution application for the deceased respondent showing their intention for prosecuting the appeal. Considering all these aspects of the case we are of the view that the appeal has merit. 

 5. The impugned order No.154 dated 19.11.2005 passed by the learned Joint District Judge, First Court, Faridpur in Miscellaneous Case No.64 of 2003 is set aside. Title Appeal No.147 of 1985 is re-admitted to its original file and number. Plaintiff appellant are directed to pay sum of Tk.5000/- (five thousand) to the defendants-respondent within 60 (sixty) days from the date of receipts of this order.
